artboards.title: Shared compact picker: constant draft and Uniform live editing, RGB/RGBA

sourceReferences.statement: Owner-approved compact layout and editing policy, delivered in Legacy 0.8.273. RGB omits A and formats6 HEX; RGBA includes A and formats8 HEX including FF.
Evidence reference only; atlas does not import or execute product source.

interactions: Simultaneous H/S/V and R/G/B; A only for RGBA.
Centered swatches/plane/eyedropper trio; right Apply only in constant mode, X always cancels.
Constant edits are draft-only; Apply writes once; outside/X/Escape cancel.
Uniform demo updates a local model live; outside accepts, X/Escape restore the whole opening value.
Enter normalizes the field only; unchanged Apply does not write.
RGB/RGBA and live/constant demo controls, model value and reopen live outside the product specimen.
RGBA6-digit paste preserves Alpha; blur/change/Enter normalizes8. RGB rejects8.
44 TD reference swatches, corner add, six session swatches beside HEX.
Pointer/keyboard edits; pointer cancel restores gesture basis; stale events fenced.
Invalid draft retained until corrected or whole-opening cancellation; Apply disabled, X remains available.
Exact raw RGB/HDR/Alpha survive projection, reopen and no-op Apply; only explicit edits modify the local color.
Eyedropper entrance only, not operational screen capture.
preserve: Shared design at color-valued entry points
limits: No product, Graph, History or Host writes
Local demonstration of delivered product commit/cancel policy; no TD, CAS, receipt, external-writer or Undo simulation
No screen capture or browser/CEF/device qualification
CSS sRGB0–1 is not shader-wide clamp

validation.scope: Local model transitions and DOM/canvas-double behavior, not browser or product acceptance

productEvidence.scope: Previously delivered product results, recorded separately; not rerun by atlas and not refactor acceptance
